findings.explanation: Toys/premium commission rate is 17%. Expected fee = round(5114.31*0.17)=869.43, but settlement row ST-0300021 charged fee -969.16, i.e. 99.73 BRL too much commission withheld. Expected net 4222.98 vs observed 4123.25.

Home/premium commission rate is 17%. Expected fee = round(2006.08*0.17)=341.03, but settlement row ST-0300006 charged fee -400.21, i.e. 59.18 BRL too much commission withheld. Expected net 1625.15 vs observed 1565.97.

Order MLB-030022 (gross 64.74) has two separate payment rows (ST-0300026 and ST-0300057) each with the full gross 64.74 and full commission -16.61, instead of one payment (or a legitimate split with fees only on the first row and no fees on the second). This doubles the settlement: observed net 96.26 vs expected 48.13, an excess of 48.13 paid to the seller.

Order MLB-030048 (fashion/classic, gross 42.15, delivered) has zero settlement rows, but expected a payment row with fee -11.73 (13% commission + 6.25 low-ticket fee) and net 30.42. Seller was never paid for this delivered order.

Settlement row ST-0400068 (gross 214.15, fee -27.84, net 186.31) references order MLB-049648, which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. There is no corresponding sale to justify this settlement.

Order is weight_class 'heavy', so contractual shipping deduction should be 39.90 (gross 3043.08 >= 79). Settlement row ST-0400057 deducted -61.80 in shipping instead, an overcharge of 21.90 (expected net 2485.86 vs observed net 2463.96).

Order is weight_class 'standard', so contractual shipping deduction should be 21.90 (gross 882.88 >= 79). Settlement row ST-0400067 deducted -39.90 in shipping instead (the 'heavy' rate), an overcharge of 18.00 (expected net 772.69 vs observed net 754.69).

Order status=refunded, full refund of gross 1211.46 expected. Only the payment row (net 1026.18) was settled; the required refund row (gross -1211.46, fee +145.38, net -1066.08) never appeared. Expected net total = -39.90, observed = 1026.18.

Delivered order (home/premium/heavy, gross 909.36) has zero settlement rows at all. Expected payment row: gross 909.36, fee -154.59 (17% premium home), shipping -39.90, net 714.87. Observed net = 0.00.
Order status=cancelled; per rules cancelled orders must carry NO settlement rows. A payment row was nevertheless settled: gross 363.23, fee -54.48, shipping -21.90, net 286.85.

Full refund of gross 38.40 (fashion/classic, commission 11.24 incl. low-ticket fee). Expected refund row: gross -38.40, fee +11.24 (commission returned), net -27.16. Observed refund row: fee 0.00, net -38.40 - the commission was not returned to the seller. Net total expected 0.00 vs observed -11.24.

Toys/premium order, gross 434.84, contracted commission rate 17% -> expected fee -73.92 (expected net 339.02 after -21.90 shipping). Observed fee is -82.62, i.e. ~19% of gross, giving observed net 330.32 - an overcharge of 8.70 in marketplace fee.

Partial refund of 1158.25 out of gross 1930.41 (60%). Per rules, refund row must return marketplace_fee = round_half_up(commission*60%) = round_half_up(308.87*0.6) = 185.32. Observed refund row has marketplace_fee=0.00, so the seller never got the commission refunded. Expected refund net = -972.93, observed = -1158.25 (diff 185.32); total order expected net 608.71 vs observed 423.39.
Order is 'paid' (fashion/premium, gross 236.59) with expected payment settlement net 172.10 (fee -42.59, shipping -21.90), but there are zero settlement rows for this order at all.

Order gross 67.18 (books/classic, low-ticket fee applies) should settle once with net 47.96. Two identical payment rows exist (ST-0600112 and ST-0600145), each gross 67.18/fee -19.22/net 47.96, summing to net 95.92 - double the expected 47.96.
Order weight_class is 'standard' so shipping should be -21.90, but the settlement row deducted -39.90 (the 'heavy' rate). Difference of 18.00 improperly charged to the seller.

Expected commission for electronics/classic on gross 131.36 (unit 65.68<79 so low-ticket fee 6.25*2=12.5 applies) = round(131.36*0.11)=14.45+12.50=26.95. Observed fee is -29.41, an overcharge of 2.46 beyond the contractual commission.
Order weight_class is 'standard' so shipping should be -21.90, but the settlement row deducted -39.90 (the 'heavy' rate), a 18.00 overcharge; commission portion (-37.04) is correct.

Order is electronics/premium, gross 108.54, unit 36.18<79 so low-ticket fee 6.25*3=18.75 applies. Expected commission = round(108.54*0.16)=17.37+18.75=36.12. Observed fee is -38.05, an overcharge of 1.93 versus the contractual fee; shipping (-21.90) is correct.

Settlement row ST-0700194 (payment, gross 662.56, fee -86.13, net 576.43) references order MLB-079870, which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. No corresponding sale can justify this credit.

Order MLB-070061 (delivered, electronics/classic, gross 113.30, standard shipping) has an expected settlement of gross 113.30 - commission 12.46 - shipping 21.90 = net 78.94, but zero settlement rows exist for it.

Order MLB-070067 has status 'cancelled', which per rules must carry NO settlement rows (expected net 0.00). Instead, settlement row ST-0700195 shows a payment of gross 77.33, fee -19.40, net 57.93 that was paid out despite the cancellation.

Order MLB-070006 is partially_refunded (refund_amount 45.76 on gross 76.26, fashion/classic 13% commission + low-ticket fee => commission 16.16). Expected settlement = payment row net 60.10 PLUS a refund row of gross -45.76, fee +9.70, net -36.06 (expected total net 24.04). Only the payment row (net 60.10) was settled; the refund row was never generated, leaving the seller with the full 60.10 instead of the correct 24.04.

Order MLB-070119 is weight_class 'heavy', so the contractual shipping deduction is 39.90 (expected net = 1756.35 - 193.20 - 39.90 = 1523.25). The settlement row ST-0700144 instead deducted shipping of 61.80 (net 1501.35), an excess deduction of 21.90 (61.80-39.90) that does not match any valid shipping tier.

Order MLB-070003 (toys/premium, gross 244.74, unit price 122.37 so no low-ticket fee) should be charged commission at 17%: round_half_up(244.74*0.17)=41.61, giving expected net 181.23. Settlement row ST-0700003 charged fee -45.99 instead, a 4.38 overcharge (45.99-41.61), producing observed net 176.85.

Order gross is 2602.59 (qty=3 x 867.53, electronics/classic/heavy, commission 11% = 286.28, shipping 39.90 for heavy). Expected a single payment row netting 2276.41. Settlement statement shows TWO identical payment rows (ST-0800221 and ST-0800233), each with gross 2602.59, fee -286.28, ship -39.90, net 2276.41 - i.e. the same payment was settled twice (not a legitimate split, since a split would carry the fees only once and split the gross, not duplicate it in full). Total observed net 4552.82 vs expected 2276.41.

Order status is 'cancelled' (toys/premium, gross 431.24). Per rules, cancelled orders must have NO settlement rows. However a payment row ST-0800232 exists with gross 431.24, fee -73.31, ship -21.90, net 336.03, meaning the seller was paid for an order that was cancelled before payment.

Order MLB-080173 (fashion/classic, gross 130.24, unit_price 65.12<79 so low-ticket fee applies) is 'delivered' with expected commission 13%+6.25*2 low-ticket fee = 29.43, shipping 21.90, expected net 78.91. No settlement rows exist for this order at all (0 rows).

Order MLB-080018 is partially_refunded with refund_amount 344.84 on gross 1149.47 (commission 12% = 137.94). Per the partial-refund rule, the refund row must return commission proportional to the refund percentage: fee=+round(137.94*344.84/1149.47)=+41.38, giving expected refund net of -303.46 and expected total net 686.17. The observed refund row ST-0800023 has fee=0.00 (no commission returned), net -344.84, giving observed total net 644.79 - short by exactly 41.38, the unreturned commission.

Order MLB-080068 is electronics/premium/heavy, gross 554.35 >=79 so seller pays 'heavy' shipping of 39.90. Expected payment row: fee -88.70 (16% commission, matches observed), ship -39.90, net 425.75. Observed row ST-0800078 deducted ship -61.80 instead of -39.90 (an extra 21.90, equal to a full standard shipping charge stacked on top), giving observed net 403.85 - short by 21.90.

Order MLB-080113 is fashion/premium, gross 734.75, correct commission rate is 18% = round(734.75*0.18)=132.26, expected net 580.59. Observed payment row ST-0800128 charged fee -146.51 (effective ~19.94% rate) instead of -132.26, an overcharge of 14.25, giving observed net 566.34 instead of expected 580.59.

Order MLB-080086 is electronics/classic, gross 4219.64, correct commission is 11% = round(4219.64*0.11)=464.16, expected net 3715.58. Observed payment row ST-0800098 charged fee -464.62 instead of -464.16, an overcharge of 0.46 (exceeds the 0.02 rounding tolerance), giving observed net 3715.12 instead of expected 3715.58.

Order status is 'refunded' (full refund of gross 3246.00, electronics/premium/heavy, commission rate 16%). Expected settlement = payment row (net 2686.74) + refund row (gross -3246.00, fee +519.36, net -2726.64), for an expected total net of -39.90. Only the payment row (net 2686.74) is present; no refund row was ever settled. Observed total net = 2686.74 vs expected -39.90.

Order gross 521.19 (fashion/premium) should settle once: fee -93.81, shipping -21.90, net 405.48 (calc_expected confirms single expected line). Two identical payment rows were posted (ST-0900109 and ST-0900297), each with gross 521.19, fee -93.81, ship -21.90, net 405.48 - a true split settlement would carry fees only on the first row and no fees on the second, not an identical duplicate. Observed total net 810.96 vs expected 405.48.

Settlement row ST-0900298 (gross 425.56, fee -55.32, net 370.24) references order MLB-099824, which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. There is no corresponding order to justify this settlement.

Order is fashion/classic, commission rate 13%, gross 1594.57 -> expected commission = round(1594.57*0.13) = 207.29, expected payment-row fee -207.29. Observed payment row (ST-0900165) charged fee -251.14, an overcharge of 251.14-207.29 = 43.85 on the payment leg alone.

Order is a full refund (refund=1594.57); rules require the refund row to return the commission: expected refund row = gross -1594.57, fee +207.29, net -1387.28. Observed refund row (ST-0900166) shows fee 0.00 and net -1594.57, i.e. the 207.29 commission was never credited back to the seller.

Order MLB-090238 (home/classic, gross 229.44, unit 76.48<79 so low-ticket fee applies) is status 'paid' with expected commission -46.28 (incl. low-ticket fee) and shipping -21.90, expected net 161.26. No settlement rows exist for this order at all (rows_observed=0), so the seller was never paid.

Order is home/classic, commission rate 12%, gross 2272.51 -> expected commission = round(2272.51*0.12) = 272.70, expected fee -272.70 (shipping heavy -39.90 correctly applied, matches observed). Observed payment row (ST-0900105) fee is -335.42, an overcharge of 335.42-272.70 = 62.72, which fully explains the net delta (-62.72).

Order is home/premium, commission rate 17%, gross 2303.40 -> expected commission = round(2303.40*0.17) = 391.58, expected fee -391.58 (shipping heavy -39.90 matches observed). Observed payment row (ST-0900046) fee is -442.95, an overcharge of 442.95-391.58 = 51.37, matching the full net delta (-51.37).

Order weight_class is 'standard' with gross 2534.22 (>=79), so expected shipping deduction is 21.90, giving expected net 2056.16. Observed payment row (ST-0900288) deducted shipping -39.90 (the 'heavy' rate) instead of -21.90, an overcharge of 39.90-21.90 = 18.00, matching the full net delta (-18.00) exactly; fee (-456.16) matches the correct 18% premium/fashion commission.
Settlement row ST-1000340 (payment, gross 661.91, fee -86.05, net 575.86) references order MLB-109378 which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. No order justifies this payout.

Order MLB-100150 (status paid, gross 419.68, home/classic/heavy) has zero settlement rows. Expected payment row: gross 419.68, fee -50.36 (12%), shipping -39.90 (heavy), net 329.42. Observed net 0.00.
Order MLB-100045 has status cancelled (must have NO settlement rows per rules), but settlement row ST-1000339 shows a payment of gross 52.58, fee -11.51, net 41.07.

Order MLB-100069 is weight_class 'standard' (gross 432.18 >=79), so expected shipping deduction is -21.90, giving expected net 336.81 (fee -73.47 matches observed). Observed row ST-1000075 deducted -39.90 (heavy rate) giving net 318.81, an over-deduction of 18.00.

Order MLB-100060 fully refunded (gross 74.56, commission 17.43 at 15%+low-ticket). Expected refund row: gross -74.56, fee +17.43 (commission returned), net -57.13. Observed refund row ST-1000066 shows fee 0.00, net -74.56 - the commission was never returned to the seller, a shortfall of 17.43.

Order MLB-100168 is fashion/premium, commission rate 18%: expected fee = round(406.02*0.18) = 73.08, expected net 311.04 (shipping -21.90 correct). Observed row ST-1000185 charged fee -84.49, net 299.63, an overcharge of 11.41.

Order MLB-100300 is fully refunded (gross 17.83). Expected: payment row (net 8.37) plus refund row (gross -17.83, fee +9.46, net -8.37) for an expected total net of 0.00. Only the payment row (ST-1000337, net 8.37) exists; the refund was never settled, leaving the seller holding 8.37 that should have been reversed.

Order MLB-100187 is books/premium, commission rate 15%: expected fee = round(2380.47*0.15) = 357.07, expected net 2001.50 (shipping -21.90 correct). Observed row ST-1000205 charged fee -357.75, net 2000.82, an overcharge of 0.68.

Order status is 'cancelled' (home/heavy, gross 1465.32). Per rule #6, cancelled orders must have NO settlement rows. Instead a payment row ST-1100398 was settled: gross 1465.32, fee -175.84, ship -39.90, net 1249.58, vs expected net 0.00.

Order MLB-110089 (toys/classic, gross 811.30) is status 'paid' with no chargeback/cancellation, expected settlement net 692.04 (commission 11% + shipping 21.90 per calc_expected), but zero settlement rows exist for this order.

Order MLB-110328 (electronics/classic, gross 272.00) has two payment rows (ST-1100368, ST-1100397), each carrying full gross 272.00, fee -29.92 and shipping -21.90 (net 220.18 each), totaling 440.36. Per rule #7, a legitimate split must carry fees on only the FIRST row and no fees on the second; here both rows are identical, i.e. the payment was duplicated rather than split. Expected total net is 220.18 (single settlement).

Order MLB-110334 (home/premium, gross 1200.66) is 'partially_refunded' with refund_amount 240.13 (20%). Expected settlement includes a refund row: gross -240.13, fee +40.82 (17% commission returned on 20%), net -199.31, for an expected total net of 757.34. Only the payment row (net 956.65) is present; no refund row was settled, leaving the seller credited the full amount despite the refund.

Order MLB-110166 (electronics/premium, gross 1581.29) should be charged commission at 16% = round_half_up(1581.29*0.16) = 253.01, giving expected net 1288.38 (with shipping -39.90 heavy, correct). Order MLB-110151 is weight_class 'standard' (gross 203.35 >=79), so expected shipping deduction is 21.90. Settlement row ST-1100167 deducted -39.90 (the 'heavy' rate) instead, overcharging shipping by 18.00.

Order MLB-110151 (toys/premium, gross 203.35) should be charged commission at 17% = round_half_up(203.35*0.17) = 34.57. Settlement row ST-1100167 charged fee -37.99, an overcharge of 3.42 beyond the correct commission, in addition to the shipping error on the same row (total row delta 21.42 = 18.00 shipping + 3.42 commission).

Order MLB-110265 is weight_class 'standard' (gross 1925.44), so expected shipping deduction is 21.90 (commission of 18% = 346.58 matches observed exactly). Settlement row ST-1100296 deducted -39.90 (heavy rate) instead of -21.90, overcharging shipping by 18.00 and reducing net from expected 1556.96 to observed 1538.96.

Observed refund row ST-1100109 shows fee 0.00 (no commission returned), net -101.55, making observed total net 49.18 -- the seller was shorted the 15.23 commission refund.

Order is 'paid' with gross 1482.47 (home/classic/heavy). Expected settlement net = 1264.67 (commission 12% = 177.90, shipping -39.90). No settlement rows exist at all (observed net 0.00). Entire expected payment never settled.

Partially refunded order (30% of 6167.82 = 1233.56 refunded gross). Contractual refund row should be gross -1233.56, fee +160.36 (proportional commission return, 20%*801.82), net -1073.20. Observed refund row ST-1200062 has fee 0.00, net -1233.56 - the commission was never returned to the seller.
Order status is 'cancelled' (gross 217.59) - per rules, cancelled orders must have NO settlement rows. However settlement row ST-1200462 was posted with net 153.01 (fee -42.68, shipping -21.90).

Order gross 78.41 (electronics/premium, low-ticket fee applies) has one legitimate expected payment: fee -18.80, net 59.61. Two identical payment rows were posted (ST-1200056 and ST-1200460), each net 59.61, summing to 119.22 - double-paid.

Order weight_class is 'standard' so shipping should be -21.90, giving expected net 492.43 (fee -76.85). Settlement row ST-1200219 deducted -39.90 (heavy rate) instead, giving observed net 474.43 - an 18.00 excess shipping deduction.

Order gross 630.17, toys/classic = 12% commission, expected fee -75.62 (expected net 532.65). Settlement row ST-1200308 charged fee -85.20, giving observed net 523.07 - a 9.58 overcharge.
Order gross 343.59, books/classic = 10% commission, expected fee -34.36 (expected net 287.33). Settlement row ST-1200277 charged fee -41.64, giving observed net 280.05 - a 7.28 overcharge.

Order gross 2031.52, toys/classic = 12% commission, expected fee -243.78 (expected net 1765.84). Settlement row ST-1200022 charged fee -244.15, giving observed net 1765.47 - a 0.37 overcharge, above the 0.02 rounding tolerance.
